most_stock_first.why: shows the most units in stock first, the first plan the chat changed to price

cheapest_first.why: sorts by price the default way, cheapest first, instead of most expensive first

docstring_tags.why: follows the module docstring and matches the query against tags as well as names

in_stock_only.why: reuses in_stock, hiding only products with no units instead of fewer than 3

hide_3_or_fewer.why: off by one: hides products with exactly 3 units too
